query: I am an international student studying in Vantaa and my husband wants to join me. How much money do we need to show altogether in our bank accounts for his family visa?
expected_answer: Since you are a student and live in the Helsinki metropolitan area (Vantaa), the income requirement for you is EUR 800 per month, and for your spouse (the second adult) is EUR 610 per month. Therefore, you must prove a combined net income of at least EUR 1,410 per month (which equals EUR 16,920 for one year).

query: My husband is working in Tampere on a normal work permit. We have two underage children and want to join him. What is the monthly net income threshold our family needs to meet?
expected_answer: Tampere is categorized under Group 2 (other large municipalities). For a family consisting of 2 adults and 2 children, the required net monthly income is EUR 2,620. This is calculated as EUR 1,090 (first adult) + EUR 550 (second adult) + EUR 550 (first child) + EUR 430 (second child).

query: I was recently granted asylum in Finland. Can my wife and children apply to join me without having to meet the standard income requirements?
expected_answer: Yes, but they must submit their residence permit applications within a strict three-month window after you receive your positive asylum decision. Additionally, this exemption only applies if your family unit was already formed before your arrival in Finland.

query: I live in Finland on a work permit. Can I apply for a family residence permit for my adult sister to come live with me?
expected_answer: Generally, no. Under Finnish immigration law, siblings are not considered members of the immediate core family. Family residence permits are strictly restricted to your spouse (or registered partner), cohabiting partner under specific rules, and your unmarried children under the age of 18.

query: If I get a residence permit to move to Finland based on my wife's specialist permit, can I get a job, or are my working hours restricted?
expected_answer: You will have an unrestricted right to work and study. Once your family-ties residence permit is approved, you can work as an employee in any field or establish your own business as an entrepreneur, with no limits on your weekly working hours.

query: My partner and I are not married, but we have lived together for a long time. Can she apply for a family residence permit to join me in Finland?
expected_answer: Yes. To qualify as a cohabiting partner (avopuoliso) under Finnish law, you must prove that you have lived together in a shared household for at least two uninterrupted years, or that you have a child together in joint custody. You must provide official proof, such as shared tenancy or lease agreements.
